'''Prototype Lab A''' was a [[Laboratory/Legends|laboratory]] in the [[Rythani Products Building]] where a [[Rythani Products]] [[Rythani Products prototype|prototype]] weapon was developed. This lab was highly secured under the orders of [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Caerbellak]]; even [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Kalieva K'ntarr]] was unable to gain access to the lab through conventional means.<ref name="Easy">{{JournalCite|9|Easy Credits}}</ref>
